CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE E.S.INDIRESH  ORAL JUDGMENT 1.
Heard learned counsel appearing for the parties.

2. This appeal is preferred by the claimant in MVC No.673/2020 challenging the Judgment and Award dated NC: 2026:KHC-K:979 HC-KAR 28.01.2022 on the file of Senior Civil Judge and MACT-11, Aland, Kalaburagi District.

sentences.text: 2 3. Having taken note of the submissions made by the learned counsel appearing for the parties, it is not in dispute as to the injury sustained by the claimant on account of the road traffic accident that occurred on 19.05.2020.
Perusal of the evidence of P.W.2 and Exs.P6 and P8 makes it clear that claimant has sustained deep fracture apart from other injuries.
In that view of the matter, Taking into account the fact that the claimant was a driver, I am of the view that, the Tribunal ought to have taken disability to the extent of 20%.

It is also to be noted that the accident is of the year 2020 and the monthly income of the claimant has to be taken at Rs.13,750/- as per the guidelines of the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority.
By applying the appropriate multiplier of 18, the claimant is entitled for compensation of Rs.5,94,000/-(13750 x 12 x 18 x 20%) towards loss of future earnings.
Taking into account the grievous injury sustained by claimant as per Exs.P6 and P8, the award of compensation is re
- assessed as follows:
NC: 2026:KHC-K:979 HC-KAR Heads Amount (in Rupees) Pain and suffering 50,000.00
Loss of earnings during laid up 41,250.00 period (Rs.13,750 x 3) Loss of amenities 50,000.00
Loss of future of earnings 5,94,000.00
Medical expenses 96,837.00 Future medical expenses 25,000.00 Towards Attendant, food and 40,000.00 conveyance charges Total 8,97,087.00 4.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) The Miscellaneous First Appeal is allowed in part.

(ii) The claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.8,97,087/- (as against Rs.5,17,037/- awarded by the Tribunal), with interest at 6% per annum from the date of claim petition till realization.

However, in terms of the order of this NC:
2026:KHC-K:979 HC-KAR Court dated 04.01.2023, the claimant is not entitled for interest on enhanced compensation for a period of 157 days being delay in filing the appeal.
(iii) In all other respects, the Judgment and Award passed by the Tribunal shall remain unaltered.
Accordingly, the Judgment and Award dated 28.01.2022 in MVC No.673/2020 on the file of Senior Civil Judge and MACT-11, Aland, Kalaburagi District, shall stand modified.

Sd/-
